sanskrit: dhenuḥ pratnasya kāmyaṁ duhānāntaḥ putraś carati dakṣiṇāyāḥ | ā dyotaniṁ vahati śubhrayāmoṣasaḥ stomo aśvināv ajīgaḥ ||
english: The cow yielding the cherished milk of the ancient one — her son roams within the southern region. (Dawn) drives forward the luminous one with bright course; the hymn of praise has awakened the two Aśvins.

sanskrit: suyug vahanti prati vām ṛtenordhvā bhavanti pitareva medhāḥ | jarethām asmad vi paṇer manīṣāṁ yuvor avaś cakṛmā yātam arvāk ||
english: The well-yoked steeds carry (your car) toward you, O Aśvins; the prayers rise upward like the fathers (of old). Drive away from us the miserliness of the Paṇi; we have rendered your praises — come hither to us.

sanskrit: suyugbhir aśvaiḥ suvṛtā rathena dasrāv imaṁ śṛṇutaṁ ślokam adreḥ | kim aṅga vām praty avarti gam iṣṭhā hur viprāso aśvinā purājāḥ ||
english: With well-yoked horses and a well-rolling chariot, O Dasras, hear this invocation from the stone-pressing. What is the reply, O Aśvins, that the inspired sages — born of old — give back to you?

sanskrit: ā manyethām ā gataṁ kac cid evair viśve janāso aśvinā havante | imā hi vāṁ goṛjīkā madhūni pra mitrāso na dadur usro agre ||
english: Take heed and come, by whatever roads you travel; all peoples call upon you, O Aśvins. For these sweet drinks of the mountain-cow (Goṛjīkā) have been poured forth at dawn like gifts among friends.

sanskrit: tiraḥ purū cid aśvinā rajāṁsy āṅgūṣo vām maghavānā janeṣu | eha yātam pathibhir devayānair dasrāv ime vāṁ nidhayo madhūnām ||
english: O Aśvins, bountiful lords, the hymn of praise has sounded for you across many realms among the peoples. Come hither by the god-traversed paths, O Dasras — here are your stored treasures of sweet draughts.

sanskrit: purāṇam okaḥ sakhyaṁ śivaṁ vāṁ yuvor narā draviṇaṁ jahnāvyām | punaḥ kṛṇvānāḥ sakhyā śivāni madhvā madema saha nū samānāḥ ||
english: Your ancient abode, your auspicious friendship, O heroes, and your wealth (are) on the Jāhnavī (Gaṅgā). Renewing these blessed bonds of fellowship, may we rejoice together with you in sweetness now, united.

sanskrit: aśvinā vāyunā yuvaṁ sudakṣā niyudbhiś ca sajoṣasā yuvānā | nāsatyā tiroahnyaṁ juṣāṇā somam pibatam asridhā sudānū ||
english: O Aśvins, both skilled in good works, together with Vāyu and with your teams of horses, young and pleased together — O Nāsatyas, delighting beyond the passing of day, drink the Soma unfailingly, O gracious givers.

sanskrit: aśvinā pari vām iṣaḥ purūcīr īyur gīrbhir yatamānā amṛdhrāḥ | ratho ha vām ṛtajā adrijūtaḥ pari dyāvāpṛthivī yāti sadyaḥ ||
english: O Aśvins, your many refreshments have circled round you, borne on by songs, unimpeded. Your chariot born of Order, urged by the stone-presser, circles Heaven-and-Earth in a single day.

sanskrit: aśvinā madhuṣuttamo yuvākuḥ somas tam pātam ā gataṁ duroṇe | ratho ha vām bhūri varpaḥ karikrat sutāvato niṣkṛtam āgamiṣṭhaḥ ||
english: O Aśvins, come to the dwelling — the most honey-sweet Soma calls out for you; drink it. Your chariot of many a changing form gleams brightly; it has come most swiftly to the presser who has pressed the Soma.

sanskrit: mitro janān yātayati bruvāṇo mitro dādhāra pṛthivīm uta dyām | mitraḥ kṛṣṭīr animiṣābhi caṣṭe mitrāya havyaṁ ghṛtavaj juhota ||
english: Mitra, when he speaks, sets people in their proper order; Mitra upholds both the earth and the sky. Mitra watches over the peoples with unwinking eye — pour the oblation rich in ghee to Mitra.

sanskrit: pra sa mitra marto astu prayasvān yas ta āditya śikṣati vratena | na hanyate na jīyate tvoto nainam aṁho aśnoty antito na dūrāt ||
english: Let that mortal prosper, O Mitra, O Āditya, who strives to please you in accordance with your ordinance. He is not slain, not overcome, protected by you; distress does not reach him, neither from near nor from afar.

sanskrit: anamīvāsa iḻayā madanto mitajñavo varimann ā pṛthivyāḥ | ādityasya vratam upakṣiyanto vayam mitrasya sumatau syāma ||
english: Free from disease, rejoicing in refreshment, treading lightly across the breadth of the earth, dwelling near the ordinance of Āditya — may we be in the good grace of Mitra.

sanskrit: ayam mitro namasyaḥ suśevo rājā sukṣatro ajaniṣṭa vedhāḥ | tasya vayaṁ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma ||
english: This Mitra is worthy of homage, most kind, a king of good dominion — he was born as the ordainer. May we be in the good grace and blessed benevolence of him, the sacred one.

sanskrit: mahāṁ ādityo namasopasadyo yātayajjano gṛṇate suśevaḥ | tasmā etat panyatamāya juṣṭam agnau mitrāya havir ā juhota ||
english: Great is Āditya, to be approached with homage; he who orders mankind is most kind to the singer. Pour into the fire this oblation offered to Mitra, most worthy of admiration.

sanskrit: mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛto 'vo devasya sānasi | dyumnaṁ citraśravastamam ||
english: The protection of Mitra, upholder of peoples, of the divine, ever-gaining — (that protection is) the most brilliantly renowned glory.

sanskrit: abhi yo mahinā divam mitro babhūva saprathaḥ | abhi śravobhiḥ pṛthivīm ||
english: Mitra, by his greatness, has encompassed the sky with wide expanse; (he has encompassed) the earth with his glories.

sanskrit: mitrāya pañca yemire janā abhiṣṭiśavase | sa devān viśvān bibharti ||
english: The five peoples have submitted themselves to Mitra for his conquering strength. He sustains all the gods.

sanskrit: mitro deveṣv āyuṣu janāya vṛktabarhiṣe | iṣa iṣṭavratā akaḥ ||
english: Mitra, among the gods possessing life-force, has made nourishing foods for the one who has cut the sacrificial grass, for one whose vows are accomplished.

sanskrit: iheha vo manasā bandhutā nara uśijo jagmur abhi tāni vedасā | yābhir māyābhiḥ pratijūtivarpasaḥ saudhanvanā yajñiyam bhāgam ānaśa ||
english: Hither and thither, O men, the kinship with you has come by thought; the Auśijas reached those (deeds) with wisdom. By those magic skills, swiftly-changing in form, the Saudhanvanas — sons of Sudhanvan — attained their sacred share.

sanskrit: yābhiḥ śacībhiś camasāṁ apiṁśata yayā dhiyā gām ariṇīta carmaṇaḥ | yena harī manasā nirataḳṣata tena devatvam ṛbhavaḥ sam ānaśa ||
english: By those skills with which they adorned the cups; by that insight with which they freed the cow from its skin; by that mind with which they fashioned the two bay steeds — by that the Ṛbhus attained divinity.

sanskrit: indrasya sakhyam ṛbhavaḥ sam ānaśur manor napāto apaso dadhanvire | saudhanvanāso amṛtatvam erire viṣṭvī śamībhiḥ sukṛtaḥ sukṛtyayā ||
english: The Ṛbhus attained the friendship of Indra; the grandsons of Manu pressed forward with their works. The Saudhanvanas ascended to immortality, having pervaded everywhere through their labors — the well-doers through well-doing.

sanskrit: indreṇa yātha sarathaṁ sute sacāṁ atho vaśānām bhavathā saha śriyā | na vaḥ pratimai sukṛtāni vāghataḥ saudhanvanā ṛbhavo vīryāṇi ca ||
english: You travel on the same chariot as Indra at the pressing; and you share in the glory of the oblation-offerers. The singer cannot match your good deeds, O Saudhanvanas, O Ṛbhus, nor your heroic acts.

sanskrit: indra ṛbhubhir vājavaddhiḥ samukṣitaṁ sutaṁ somam ā vṛṣasva gabhastyoḥ | dhiyeṣito maghavan dāśuṣo gṛhe saudhanvanebhiḥ saha matsvā nṛbhiḥ ||
english: O Indra, with the Ṛbhus possessing prizes, sprinkle the pressed Soma in your two hands. O bountiful one, urged by prayer in the house of the pious worshipper, take joy together with the Saudhanvana men.

sanskrit: indra ṛbhumān vājavān matsvehā no 'smin savane śacyā puruṣṭuta | imāni tubhyaṁ svasarāṇi yemire vratā devānām manuṣaś ca dharmabhiḥ ||
english: O Indra, together with the Ṛbhus and the prize-winners, rejoice here in us at this pressing by your power, O much-praised one. These daily observances have been set in order for you through the ordinances of the gods and of Manu.

sanskrit: indra ṛbhubhir vājibhir vājayann iha stomaṁ jaritur upa yāhi yajñiyam | śataṁ ketebhir iṣirebhir āyave sa hasraṇītho adhvarasya homani ||
english: O Indra, together with the Ṛbhus and the prize-winners, seeking prizes, come here to the sacrificial hymn of the singer. With a hundred swift banners, O guide of thousands, come to the oblation-pouring of this sacrifice.

sanskrit: uṣo vājena vājinī pracetāḥ stomaṁ juṣasva gṛṇato maghoni | purāṇī devi yuvatiḥ puraṁdhir anu vrataṁ carasi viśvavāre ||
english: O Uṣas, possessing prize-wealth, prize-winning, all-knowing — be pleased with the hymn of the singer, O bountiful one. O ancient goddess, ever-young, full of insight, you walk according to the eternal ordinance, O all-desired one.

sanskrit: uṣo devy amartуā vi bhāhi candrarathā sūnṛtā īrayantī | ā tvā vahantu suyamāso aśvā hiraṇyavarṇām pṛthupājaso ye ||
english: O Uṣas, immortal goddess, shine forth — you who travel in a bright chariot, bringing pleasant truths. Let the well-guided steeds bear you, golden-hued, broad in splendor.

sanskrit: uṣaḥ pratīcī bhuvanāni viśvordhvā tiṣṭhasy amṛtasya ketuḥ | samānam arthaṁ caraṇīyamānā cakram iva navyasy ā vavṛtsva ||
english: O Uṣas, facing all beings of the universe, you stand high as the banner of immortality. Moving toward the same goal, roll forward like the wheel of a new (wagon).

sanskrit: ava syūmeva cinvatī maghoн uṣā yāti svasarasya patnī | svar janantī subhagā sudaṁsā āntād divaḥ paprathu ā pṛthivyāḥ ||
english: Gathering like threads from a spindle, O bountiful Dawn, the consort of the sun goes forth. Generating light, the fortunate one of beautiful works has spread herself from the edge of the sky to the earth.

sanskrit: acchā vo devīm uṣasaṁ vibhātīm pra vo bharadhvaṁ namasā suvṛktim | ūrdhvam madhvadhā divi pājo aśret pra rocanā ruruce raṇvasaṁdṛk ||
english: Toward the shining goddess Uṣas bring forward your well-fashioned hymn of praise with homage. The honey-placing one has stretched her power aloft in the sky; the radiant spaces have blazed forth, delightful to behold.

sanskrit: ṛtāvarī divo arkair abodhy ā revatī rodasī citram asthāt | āyatīm agna uṣasaṁ vibhātīm vāmam eṣi draviṇam bhikṣamāṇaḥ ||
english: The guardian of Order was awakened by the rays of the sky; the rich one has stood brilliantly on both world-halves. O Agni, you who beg, you approach lovely wealth — the far-coming, brightly shining Uṣas.

sanskrit: ṛtasya budhna uṣasām iṣaṇyan vṛṣā mahī rodasī ā viveśa | mahī mitrasya varuṇasya māyā candreva bhānuṁ vi dadhe purutrā ||
english: From the foundation of cosmic Order, urging on the Dawns, the bull has entered the mighty heaven-and-earth. The great magic wisdom of Mitra and Varuṇa has spread its light in many places like the moon.

sanskrit: imā u vām bhṛgayo manyamānā yuvāvate na tujyā abhūvan | kva tyad indrāvaruṇā yaśo vāṁ yena smā sinam bharathaḥ sakhibhyaḥ ||
english: These Bhṛgus, meditating upon you, have become (powerful) like missiles driven by you two. Where, O Indra and Varuṇa, is that glory of yours by which you ever bring gain to your friends?

sanskrit: ayam u vām purutamo rayīyañ chaśvattamam avase johavīti | sajoṣāv indrāvaruṇā marudbhir divā pṛthivyā śṛṇutaṁ havam me ||
english: This one, most numerous of your worshippers, rich in wealth, calls out again and again for your help. O Indra and Varuṇa, united with the Maruts, hear my invocation from heaven and earth.

sanskrit: asme tad indrāvaruṇā vasu ṣyād asme rayir marutaḥ sarvavīraḥ | asmān varūtrīḥ śaraṇair avantv asmān hotrā bhāratī dakṣiṇābhiḥ ||
english: May that treasure be ours, O Indra and Varuṇa; may that wealth of all heroes be ours, O Maruts. May the protective goddesses shelter us with their shelters; may Bhāratī (Sarasvatī), as Hotrā, (favor) us with her bounties.

sanskrit: bṛhaspate juṣasva no havyāni viśvadevya | rāsva ratnāni dāśuṣe ||
english: O Bṛhaspati, lord of all the gods, be pleased with our offerings. Bestow precious gifts upon the pious worshipper.

sanskrit: śucim arkair bṛhaspati madhvareṣu namasyata | anāmy oja ā cake ||
english: Worship Bṛhaspati the pure with hymns at the sacrifices. He has shown forth matchless strength.

sanskrit: vṛṣabhaṁ carṣaṇīnāṁ viśvarūpam adābhyam | bṛhaspatiṁ vareṇyam ||
english: Bṛhaspati the bull of the peoples, all-formed, undeceivable — him we choose as most excellent.

sanskrit: iyaṁ te pūṣann āghṛṇe suṣṭutir deva navyasī | asmābhis tubhyaṁ śasyate ||
english: O Pūṣan, O radiant god, this newest excellent praise-song is recited by us for you.

sanskrit: tāṁ juṣasva giram mama vājayantīm avā dhiyam | vadhūyur iva yoṣaṇām ||
english: Be pleased with this speech of mine that seeks the prize; promote (my) thought — as a bridegroom (desires) a maiden.

sanskrit: yo viśvābhi vipaśyati bhuvanā saṁ ca paśyati | sa naḥ pūṣāvitā bhuvat ||
english: He who looks out over all the worlds and surveys them together — may that Pūṣan be our protector.

sanskrit: tat savituḥ vareṇyaṁ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
english: We meditate upon that most excellent splendor of divine Savitṛ — may he impel our thoughts.

sanskrit: devasya savituḥ vayaṁ vājayantaḥ puraṁdhyā | bhagasya rātim īmahe ||
english: We, seeking the prize with (our) insight, implore the divine gift of Savitṛ (and) of Bhaga.

sanskrit: devaṁ naraḥ savitāraṁ viprā yajñaiḥ suvṛktibhiḥ | namasyanti dhiyeṣitāḥ ||
english: The inspired men, urged by prayer, worship divine Savitṛ with well-formed sacrifices and with homage.

sanskrit: somo jigāti gātuvid devānām eti niṣkṛtam | ṛtasya yonim āsadam ||
english: Soma goes, knowing the way; he proceeds to the purified (dwelling) of the gods. He takes his seat in the womb of cosmic Order.

sanskrit: somo asmabhyaṁ dvipade catuṣpade ca paśave | anamīvā iṣas karat ||
english: May Soma make nourishing foods, free from disease, for us — both for the two-footed and the four-footed creature.

sanskrit: asmākam āyur vardhayann abhimātīḥ sahamānaḥ | somaḥ sadhasatham āsadat ||
english: Increasing our life-span, overwhelming our adversaries, may Soma take his seat in the common gathering-place.

sanskrit: ā no mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtair gavyūtim ukṣatam | madhvā rajāṁsi sukratū ||
english: O Mitra and Varuṇa, sprinkle our pasture with ghee; O you of good wisdom, bedew the realms with sweetness.

sanskrit: uruśaṁsā namovṛdhā mahnā dakṣasya rājathaḥ | drāghiṣṭhābhiḥ śucivratā ||
english: O widely praised ones, growing great through homage, you two reign by the greatness of (your) power. With your longest (reach), O pure in vow.

sanskrit: gṛṇānā jamadagninā yonāv ṛtasya sīdatam | pātaṁ somam ṛtāvṛdhā ||
english: Being praised by Jamadagni, sit in the womb of cosmic Order. Drink the Soma, O you who strengthen Order.
